title: Logging Equipment Operators
description: Drive logging tractor or wheeled vehicle equipped with one or more accessories, such as bulldozer blade, frontal shear, grapple, logging arch, cable winches, hoisting rack, or crane boom, to fell tree; to skid, load, unload, or stack logs; or to pull stumps or clear brush. Includes operating stand-alone logging machines, such as log chippers.

tasks.text: Control hydraulic tractors equipped with tree clamps and booms to lift, swing, and bunch sheared trees.

Drive straight or articulated tractors equipped with accessories such as bulldozer blades, grapples, logging arches, cable winches, and crane booms to skid, load, unload, or stack logs, pull stumps, or clear brush.
Drive crawler or wheeled tractors to drag or transport logs from felling sites to log landing areas for processing and loading.
Drive tractors for building or repairing logging and skid roads.
Inspect equipment for safety prior to use, and perform necessary basic maintenance tasks.

clusters.label: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Grade logs according to characteristics such as knot size and straightness, and according to established industry or company standards.
Drive and maneuver tractors and tree harvesters to shear the tops off of trees, cut and limb the trees, and cut the logs into desired lengths.
Fill out required job or shift report forms.

clusters.label: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Calculate total board feet, cordage, or other wood measurement units, using conversion tables.
